name: GATSBY'S DISSOLUTION
blurb: Aiming through a trembling sight, hold your nerve as Gatsby turns toward the pool.
how: Move the mouse to aim through the shaking sights. Left click to fire once Gatsby looks toward the pool. The bullet follows in slow motion.

win.title: THE LAST LIGHT
win.body: The shot breaks the stillness beside the pool. Gatsby's bright summer ends in a scatter of water, fading light, and silence.
win.quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.

lose.title: THE MOMENT PASSES
lose.body: The trembling sight never settles on its mark before the night slips away. The pool remains still beneath the green glow.
lose.quote: Can't repeat the past? Why of course you can!
